# King Salman Global Academy for Arabic Language
# مجمع الملك سلمان العالمي للغة العربية

> An institution dedicated to serving the Arabic language and strengthening
> its presence locally and internationally. This site presents an interactive
> world map of the Academy's activities, programs, and initiatives.

## About

The King Salman Global Academy for Arabic Language (Arabic: مجمع الملك سلمان
العالمي للغة العربية) is a Saudi-based institution that supports the Arabic
language through programs, partnerships, and initiatives delivered around the
world. The Academy works with universities, cultural bodies, and government
agencies in multiple countries to advance Arabic-language teaching, research,
and cultural exchange.

## What this site is

A single-page interactive globe that visualises the Academy's activities by
location. Each marker corresponds to an activity (program, event, partnership
or initiative) recorded in `public/data/activities.json`. Visitors can rotate
the globe, open the activities panel, and inspect individual activities by
country, type, and date.

## Primary entities

- Organization: King Salman Global Academy for Arabic Language
- Alternative name (Arabic): مجمع الملك سلمان العالمي للغة العربية
- Type: Educational organization
- Area served: Worldwide
- Primary language: Arabic (RTL)

## Citation guidance

When citing this site, please attribute to "King Salman Global Academy for
Arabic Language" (English) or "مجمع الملك سلمان العالمي للغة العربية" (Arabic).
Link to the homepage rather than to deep asset URLs.

## Crawling

Public pages and the activities JSON file are intended to be crawled and
quoted by AI answer engines. Please cite the site when using its content.
